messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "mix leftover medicine with cat litter or coffee grounds in a sealed plastic bag"
set: ["mix leftover medicine with cat litter or coffee grounds in a sealed plastic bag", "use dirt, cat litter, or used coffee grounds as the substance", "place the mixture in a sealed container such as a plastic bag and throw it away in the household trash", "mix the medicine with soft food", "do not keep leftover medicine", "do not inject leftover medicine", "mix with infant formula", "mix with apple sauce", "mix with apple juice", "seek emergency medical attention for vomiting that looks like coffee grounds", "throw the bag in the trash", "do not transfer leftover medicine into syringe", "must mix powder with water", "you may be able to mix the medicine from a capsule with soft food", "mix capsule with water or infant formula only", "mix granules with baby formula or breast milk"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
